in_marathi.name: Nirupama
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nirupama हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nirupama refers to the incomparable or unparalleled. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'niru' meaning inexpressible and 'upama' meaning comparison. In Hindu mythology, Nirupama is a name given to the goddess Lakshmi, representing her as the one who is incomparable and beyond all forms.
